newsitem.title: USA: Edison Mohave coal unit 1 cut to 670 MW.
newsitem.headline: Edison Mohave coal unit 1 cut to 670 MW.

text.p: The 790 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Mohave coal-fired power plant near Laughlin, Nev., is operating at 670 MW due to a mill fire, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Wednesday.
The unit was shut last Friday for work on its precipitator controls, but was partially restarted earlier this week.
The latest curtailment will probably last until later Wednesday evening, the sources said.
Mohave's unit 2 is said to be operating close to its 790 MW capacity at 770 MW.
The Mohave plant is majority owned and operated by Edison International's Southern California Edison Co.
